answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 181196 Country: India Title: Right posture for Salah Question: My question is that, whether in the light of Shariah and Sunnah Muhamad PBUH, due to aching knee problem whether offering prayer in sitting posture or sitting on the chair is better of the two. Which is more advisable, while still on the prayer mat or on a chair. Please advise. Answer ID: 181196 Posted on: Feb 20, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 505/424/M=6/1442) If one has so much pain in knee that he is unable to offer Salah with sajdah, but he can offer salah while sitting on a mat, then it is better not to use a chair and offer salah sitting on the mat with gesture. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
